status: candidate protocol; main execution requires freeze.json
design: post-hoc controlled evaluation, conditional on one trained model and one fixed finite state bank
source_policy: authenticated preserved training closure; do not import changed current checkout code

state_law.source: 64 distinct original source episodes, selected by seeded episode IDs without outcomes
state_law.probability: uniform over the 64 fixed rows for both fresh calibration and evaluation

action_law.grid: cartesian product of [-1,-float32(0.8),0,float32(0.8),1] in four coordinates, 625 commands
action_law.beta: exact product categorical source: 0.84 at each coordinate's nearest controller atom; 0.04 at each other atom
action_law.weights: exact q_lambda/beta; zero weights allowed; no ratio clipping or denominator floor
action_law.off_grid_actor: separate structural support audit, no projection-based support claim for the deployed actor

score.predictor: terminal100k minimum of the two current critic heads
score.label: r+(1-done)*min_Qtarget(s_next,clip(actor_target(s_next)+clip(0.2*N(0,I),-0.5,0.5),-1,1))
score.termination: remaining-time observation; no bootstrap at time99 transition
score.definition: abs(Y100k-Q100k)/scale; fresh identically computed scores for both banks and methods
score.label_noise: fixed conditional kernel, no importance ratio assigned to clipped Gaussian label noise

calibration.coupling: same calibration rows, scores and exponential posterior draws across both methods and all target mixtures
calibration.test_mass_iw: q_lambda(query)/beta(query), per-query variant; not scalar E_target[w]
calibration.threshold: max(weighted empirical 0.9 quantile, posterior 0.95 order statistic of 0.9 crossings with test mass at infinity)
calibration.all_zero: explicit no-positive-weight-bank refusal; infinite interval, neutral dose1; not formula failure
calibration.guarantee: BCA-specific Bayesian procedure evaluated empirically; no weighted-conformal frequentist theorem asserted
calibration.arithmetic: native float64 WBCP threshold; both methods use float64 half-width and dose evaluation, not a claim of bitwise float32 deployment readout

evaluation.coupling: same query bank between methods; common state IDs, base actions, mixture uniforms and Gaussian label noise across mixture levels within a replication
evaluation.independence: new draws independent of calibration within each replicate; all draw streams independent across calibration replications
evaluation.raw_records: retain each replicate's calibration and evaluation arrays locally; portable bundle includes per-replicate paired records, identities, seeds and replay code
evaluation.inference_unit: independent calibration replication (200); queries are not independent replicates for uncertainty of the procedure
evaluation.interval: mean +/- two-sided t_199 97.5% critical value times across-replication standard error; paired differences use paired replicate differences
evaluation.scope: conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty, not across-trained-seed or new-episode population uncertainty

dose.interpretation: diagnostic native multiplier readout only; no actor or optimizer update; finite usability is not support certification

execution.resume: only complete checksum-verified replication files may be reused; incomplete replication is recomputed from its fixed independent streams and recorded
